segments.text: The mother of Cloche, who was assassinated prior to the events of the game.
She is the mother of Luca (the real Cloche), and asked Reisha to care for her.
Reisha's husband, and the father of Luca and Reika.

Croix Bartel is the main character of the game and a promising young knight who eventually finds himself involved in a battle far beyond his wildest imagination. He adopted a young girl called Cocona that was orphaned because of an IPD outbreak, and ended becoming a big brother for her. He becomes caught up in a rapidly-escalating civil war during one of his missions, soon finding himself directly protecting the Holy Maiden of Pastalia and in for an adventure that will decide the fate of the entire world.
Singer: Dahna
Edited from Ar tonelico Wiki

cast.characterName: 瑠珈・トゥルーリーワース
cast.originalCharacterName: 瑠珈・トゥルーリーワース

segments.text: Likes: Crafting, Leaf, peanut donuts, tomato juice
Dislikes: Kurukuru dumplings, raw tomatoes, bell peppers
Singer: Haruka Shimotsuki

Always cheerful and amicable, she is a childhood friend of Croix, who lived together until he moved to Pastalia. Now she is Croix's girlfriend, and people think they make a good couple. She works in Rakshek as a Dive Therapist using her Reyvateil abilities.

Even though some people hold negative connotations for this occupation, she's proud of what she does. She likes to heal people's mental wounds. She is popular among her customers and other people because of her agreeable personality. However, she seems to harbor a lot of secrets under her cheerful exterior, proving to be rather pessimistic and angry at times. Her Japanese surname "waath" means "revive" in Hymmnos language.
Edited from official site
Jacqli is a playable character in its sequel Ar tonelico II: Melody of Metafalica.

She is also reputed to be the strongest Reyvateil in the world. She had waged a war against humanity and Shurelia in the past - a war that resulted with great devastation to Sol Ciel and her subsequent imprisonment.
Singer: Noriko Mitose
Edited from Ar tonelico Wiki

Cocona is Croix Bartel's adopted little sister. She gets along with him quite well (lovingly calling him him "Cro") though thay are not related by blood, she is actually a Reyvateil herself, but she has not yet matured and is unable to use Song Magic fully. However, she is able to craft a little fireball in combat, showing that she can at least command the most basic Song Magic that all Reyvateils can use. She fights using an special hair ornament, which can turn into a double-bladed baton. This weapon idea was originally created by Croix for her.
From Ar Tonelico Wiki

segments.text: Likes: Gergo, ugly-cute creatures, Kurukuru dumplings, Pippen, fruit waffles
Dislikes: Grotesque things, horror movies, excessively sweet foods
Singer: Akiko Shikata
Said to be the "Most Valuable Life" in the world of Metalfalss. The stateswoman who represents the Grand Bell. She is also a Reyvateil.
Behind the 33rd Holy Maiden, she is an extremely charismatic idol and superstar among all people who support the Grand Bell.

She is especially popular of all the Holy Maidens in Metalfalss' history. Her speeches are very energetic, and she empowered the people with her eloquence in this stagnant phase in human history, so she has gained enormous popularity.

However, because she was raised in the Palace and has hardly gone out, she's socially ignorant and a bit awkward around people. That is probably why she is usually pompous and sometimes even intimidating.
From official site

segments.text: Likes: Her daughters, singing, cooking

Luca's mother. She lives with Luca in Mint Block. She runs farms in Mint Block and makes a living with her daughter. She lost her other daughter and Luca's sister, Leyka, during an I.P.D. outbreak, and her husband, Batz, died trying to protect Leyka.

She and Luca have been living together ever since, but when Luca revealed to be a Reyvateil at the age of 9, their relationship has been bad. Now, they hardly ever communicate at home, and even if Luca talks to her, she can only give her cold responses.
From official site

segments.text: Likes: Playing with lyre, Soope
Dislikes: Trashy people

A young woman who works as a ranger in a forest and an adventurer. She encounters Croix and his friends in a forest and starts to travel with them. She always takes Soope with her. He's been with her for as long as he can remember.

She works as a professional lyre player, as well as a ranger. Her lyre is also a versatile weapon: it can become a sword and a bow in battle. Where she is from is unknown. Due to her darker skin, some believe she is a Teru, but she doesn't have a tail or horns, the symbolical physical features of the Teru, so it seems quite certain that she is a human.
From official site
Likes: Basking the sun in the Virtual World
Dislikes: Having to do customer service for Luca

Luca's mind guardian. She refers to herself as her "agent". Because Luca is a Dive Therapist and her "customers" come into the world where Goro lives, she has to take care of them. Because of her cute appearance and contrasting voice, most customers remember her name.

In that sense, she is a celebrity, whether she likes it or not. She's normally a smiling, cheerful, and cute girl, just like Luca. You can see Luca's strong desires in the big gem that she always rides on.
From official site
Likes: Reading books, jokes
Dislikes: Dumb people, insistent people

Cloche's Mind Guardian. She is very business-like and places efficiency above anything else. She always mocks others with harsh remarks like, "You're so stupid," or "Are you dumb?" She even treats her master, Cloche, severely because of her functionalist personality.
From official site
Age: 19 (appearance only)
Likes: Surfing, martial arts
Dislikes: Shutdowns, defragment

The Guardian of the Goddess who lives up in the heavens. In the past, she led the Divine Army several times to kill people who tried to create Metafalica. Very calm. It seems she has absolutely no emotions.
From official site
Likes: Fencing, dignity and traditions of his royal family
Dislikes: The current government

The charismatic leader of the Sacred Army, and the Alfman Regime's rival force. He is actually the purest-blood heir of the Pope, who used to control the world before Alfman's coup. He is also Croix's childhood friend.
Very prideful. He ruthlessly eliminates whoever defiles the Royal Family. His love for old traditions that his clan has long preserved is behind his angers and ruthlessness to traitors.
His dream is to regain the throne and the Pope's Regime. For this purpose, he and Chester established the Sacred Army.
Edited from official site

After the events of Ar Tonelico: Melody of Elemia, Spica works as a pharmacist and is shown as a good friend of Jacqli. She still has secret items that become available after a certain amount of events, using the same password. However, she now sells accessories and consumable items at a very high price.
From Ar Tonelico Wiki

segments.text: Frelia is the Administrator of the Second Tower of Ar tonelico; and also the one that created and maintains its existence. She is called the "Goddess" by the people of Metafalss, and resides in the satellite Sol Marta, located in the highest reaches of the atmosphere. From there, she was supposed to overlook the region of Metafalss, and make sure that nothing out of normal ever happened there. Her main characteristics are her wings and hairstyle, which give her the appearance of a fairy, and her shy personality.
From Ar Tonelico Wiki
Owner of the General Store near Rakshek. She is very fond of Croix and Cloche, and looks like she has a little liking to Luca, too. She usually refers to Croix as "Cro-nii" and Cloche as "Cro-nee".
